map.提示：SAPHO综合征是一种罕见的自体炎症性骨皮肤病，病程慢性波动，可自行缓解和: Note: SAPHO syndrome is a rare autoinflammatory osteo-cutaneous disease with chronic fluctuating course, spontaneous remission and relapse. Anterior chest wall involvement (sternoclavicular/costosternal joints) is the most characteristic finding. Bone biopsy culture is usually negative (vs infectious osteomyelitis). Treatment ladder: NSAIDs → bisphosphonates (pamidronate/zoledronate, good for bone pain and osteitis) → DMARDs (methotrexate/sulfasalazine) → biologics (anti-TNF/anti-IL-1/anti-IL-17). Skin lesions are mainly treated locally. For clinical reference only.
